## BM25 normalisation ablation (recall@40 only, no reader)

frozen = repo tokenizer (normalize() + harakat strip + fold() variants + ZWNJ subtokens + number variants + stopwords) on both sides. raw_query = frozen document index, question tokenised by a plain Unicode tokenizer (lower-case only). raw_both = plain Unicode tokenizer on both sides. The corpus text itself was normalised at extraction time (normalize() is a port of the extractor rule), so 'raw_both' removes only the tokenizer-level normalisation.
